purpose: Define the bounded handoff report shape for SEIS AI Core sub-agents without enabling background automation, autonomous writes, external mutation, or secret access.

sampleHandoffs.summary: Review a documented handoff fixture and validator binding before any future write-gated sub-agent runtime promotion.
sampleHandoffs.approvalBoundary: This handoff does not authorize GitHub push, merge, SSH, deployment, provider calls, credential access, dependency installation, file deletion, or background autonomous writes.
sampleHandoffs.rollbackNote: Revert the handoff fixture and validator additions if the contract is rejected.
sampleHandoffs.nextAction: A human or separate reviewer inspects the scoped diff and validation result before any runtime promotion.

nextPromotionGate: Turn this fixture into an executable handoff report test only after permission, approval, cancellation, redaction, and ledger checks pass together.
